727270101.text: Hello there, warrior from a foreign land!

727270103.text: Indeed we meet again! You cut as dazzling a figure as ever...

727270106.text: ...Ahem, point is, it would seem that some people have been secretly organizing another Hyakunin Ikki.

727270105.text: Huh? You don't remember me? Ah, sorry, perhaps I was so busy recording your heroics in battle during the last Hyakunin Ikki that I didn't cheer loudly enough...

727270201.text: Here we are. This is the place.

727270202.text: Same rules as always: Once you enter this rather suspicious-seeming door, you'll be in the tournament venue for this round of Hyakunin Ikki.

727270207.text: Anyway, I'll be recording your heroics and cheering for you at the top of my lungs this time, too.

727270205.text: The rules probably have not changed much. Monsters, adventurers, and warriors from across Teyvat, who share a common yearning for battle, will quench their thirst on this festival stage through passionate combat.

727270206.text: And of course, just like last time, feel free to bring your friends and companions! After all, the "Hyakunin" in "Hyakunin Ikki" means that the more people you bring, the merrier!
